test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 26 Oct, 2023)
subject: general
question: In September 2022, the Government of _____________ decided to launch a campaign aimed at women’s safety titled ‘Hamar Beti Hamar Maan’ (our daughter, our honour). Its focus will be creating awareness on safety measures among school- and college going girls and prioritising registration and investigation of women-related crimes.
solution:
The correct answer is **Chhattisgarh**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chhattisgarh** launched the 'Hamar Beti Hamar Maan' campaign in September 2022.
 
• The campaign aims to create **awareness on women's safety** among school and college-going girls.
 
• It emphasizes the **registration and investigation** of women-related crimes.
 
• The initiative reflects the state's commitment to **prioritizing women's safety** and addressing gender-based violence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Keyword
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Women's Safety
 Refers to measures and policies aimed at protecting women from violence and ensuring their safety in public and private spaces.
 
 

 Gender-Based Violence
 Any harmful act directed at an individual based on their gender, including physical, sexual, and psychological abuse.
 
 

 Awareness Campaign
 A series of activities and initiatives designed to inform and educate the public about a specific issue.
 
 

 Registration of Crimes
 The official recording of a crime by the authorities, which is the first step in the investigation process.
 
 

 Investigation
 The process of inquiring into a crime or incident to gather evidence and determine the facts.
